_about: Machine form of SHOW-DIALECT-USE.md: the Syndicate register (Persona-5-derived reserved dialect; game-side law = docs/ui-art/persona-dialect/MOCHII-UI-DIALECT.md + persona-dialect-fragment.json, mochiichao/ui-dialect/v1) applied to the show's presentation furniture. The dialect styles existing seats only; it never authors content. All dose values DRAFT; story facts none.

bands.note: clean - the base presentation establishes the show's normal
bands.position: season opening through the first dojo arc

bands.note: first traces: a handful across the whole band, single-element, unattributed, unexplained
bands.position: early-mid season, before the Syndicate is named on screen

bands.note: a pattern forms near Syndicate business; the decoy's imitation appears
bands.position: mid season: Syndicate named as an organisation; Jax encountered

bands.note: Class S-A unlocks at the Syndicate's own material; density rises toward the seat; the reveal signs the register (name/face admitted on S-A; grammar unchanged)
bands.position: late season: Veil City approach, Dojo 8 material

bands.note: Class S-A follows the Syndicate wherever it operates; the dialect never becomes the show's default skin

buildUpCurve.keyedTo: season story position, never episode count or air order alone
laws: no regression of mystery: later bands never explain earlier traces; traces stay deniable after the reveal
the curve is a ceiling, not a quota: an unspent band is lawful, an over-dosed band is a defect
promo use (#156) never raises episode dose: trailers cannot spend the season's mystery early

S-A.dose: full grammar over the episode's admitted seats - slants, accent, cut-ins, splashes, collage headlines on labels/titles only
S-A.gate: episode record must carry a Syndicate-fiction key or every S-A row fails validation
S-A.name: full dialect (show)
S-A.who: Luigi / Mysterious Figure and Syndicate episodes and sequences in-fiction: his dialogue staging, Syndicate set pieces, Dojo 8 / Veil City episode material, the reveal sequence, Syndicate-subject promos (#156)

S-B.dose: fragments only over otherwise base-presentation seats: slant + one glyph family + at most ONE of {cut-in, splash/poster frame, collage headline} per seat
S-B.gate: an S-B row exceeding the fragment budget fails validation
S-B.name: high-point fragments (show)
S-B.who: season high points not owned by the Syndicate: pivotal dialogue beats, legendary-site (peak place-charge) sequences, Elite/Champion-tier staging, festival/climax staging

S-C.dose: single element only; deniable; never attributed in-fiction; no character remarks on a trace; paratext does not explain it
S-C.gate: a trace carrying attribution (name, face, organisation mark) is a defect, not a trace
S-C.name: traces (show)
S-C.who: pre-reveal unattributed intrusions: one shard transition card, one slanted transition where a straight one belongs, one glyph in a results/celebration staging

S-D.gate: any dialect element on an S-D episode record fails validation; this class is the majority of the season by design
S-D.name: base only (show)

jax.dose: S-B fragment budget, executed one degree off: opposed slant family, accent desaturated one step, compositions quoting S-A without completing them
jax.name: the decoy's lesser share (show)
jax.read: a man wearing someone else's style; whether the wrongness is ever named in-fiction is game-side OWNER SLOT 3, shared

dialect.gameSpec: docs/ui-art/persona-dialect/MOCHII-UI-DIALECT.md - this fragment's S-classes mirror its classes A/B/C/D + jax
dialect.kind: reserved presentation dialect over the show's furniture systems
dialect.name: Syndicate register (show)
dialect.ownerInFiction: the Syndicate; the leader displayed as "Mysterious Figure" (Luigi Castagnoli, Dojo 8) until the reveal
dialect.sourceGrammar: Persona 5 UI teardown (DOCS/DATA grade; no Persona code or assets) - docs/ui-art/persona-dialect/PERSONA5-UI-TEARDOWN.md

fences: creatures speak in cries only, humans in words: dialect presentation is human-world presentation; the dialect never puts words, name-tags, or text on a creature; a dialect card over a creature's moment is film furniture, never creature speech
subtitle law scarcity: a dialect card spends from the episode's existing intertitle budget; the register never adds a card
law-class wording is owner-exact: the dialect styles the plate, never the words
Chibi Card System caps apply unchanged; chibi surfaces never carry the dialect
two territories, two skins: the Syndicate register never shares palette or glyph set with the Dark Forest Unseen (Malakor) register
there is no Forest eyecatch in any register; a dialect trace at a Forest break uses the outgoing location's eyecatch or the EC-DEVICE form
the dialect never leaks a hidden true name or face before the reveal; pre-reveal presentation of the figure is silhouette/shard
part transitions are append-only: a dialect reveal never reaches back to re-dress an earlier trace
ownerSlots: 7 - show-side dose in episodes not featuring Luigi (this spec's S-B/S-C defaults are PROPOSED until ruled)
1 - the accent colour (shared with the game fragment; null until ruled - one register, one accent, both media)
2 - Luigi reveal specifics (shared; where/when/how the reveal flips and what the sequence stages)

rowKey.note: a styling key on existing furniture rows (intertitle rows, eyecatch records, title/transition declarations in the episode spec). Absent or 'none' = base presentation. Register is styling metadata only: it never changes a row's wording, casting, timing, or count.

elements: shard-tag speaker presentation on existing cards
plate styling: slant field, shard tag, rationed accent, kinetic settle
seats.host: mochiichao/intertitle-craft/v1 (List 43 #422 - built and in production use; grammar doc not yet on main at 2026-10-28 audit, flagged in SHOW-DIALECT-USE.md section 6)

elements: B-form overlay key in the register
slant field + shard punctuation on the title line
day-arrival splash cards at admitted day boundaries
per host system; promo use never raises episode dose

status: DRAFT - all dose values drafted; S-B/S-C defaults PROPOSED under owner slot 7; story facts none
validation: S-A row without a Syndicate-fiction key on the episode record = fail
S-B row over fragment budget (slant + one glyph family + >1 of {cut-in, splash/poster frame, collage headline}) = fail
S-C element carrying attribution (name/face/organisation mark) = fail
S-D episode record naming any dialect element = fail
dialect element applied to creature communication (words/name-tag/text on a creature) = fail
dialect row changing a host row's wording, casting, timing, or count = fail (register is styling only)
law-class card wording altered under a dialect plate = fail
dialect on a chibi surface = fail
Syndicate register sharing palette or glyph set with the Dark Forest Unseen register = fail
dialect-dressed Forest eyecatch (any EC-FOREST record) = fail
dialect surface leaking a hidden true name or face before the reveal = fail
